CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_Suscriptor_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0,
@Suscriptor_Id AS INT = 0

AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @SuscriptorFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		Suscriptor_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @SuscriptorFilter (Suscriptor_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Suscriptor].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Suscriptor]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[Suscriptor].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @SuscriptorFilter (Suscriptor_Id)
		SELECT DISTINCT(susc.Suscriptor_Id)
			FROM Suscripcion susc 
				JOIN Membresia memb ON susc.Membresia_Id = memb.Id
				JOIN Suscriptor sus ON susc.Suscriptor_Id = sus.Id
			WHERE 
				memb.Activo = 1
			AND memb.EstatusMembresia_Id = 1
			AND sus.Activo = 1	
			AND LTRIM(RTRIM(sus.CorreoElectronico)) <> ''
 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[Suscriptor].[Id],
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoMaterno]  as NombreCompleto,
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre],
		[Suscriptor].[ApellidoPaterno],
		[Suscriptor].[ApellidoMaterno],
		[Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico],
		[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia],
		[Comunidad].[Nombre] AS [Comunidad],
		[TipoMembresia].[Nombre] AS [Membresia],
		[TipoSuscripcion].[Nombre] AS [TipoSuscripcion],
		[Suscriptor].[UltimaAutenticacion],
		CASE ISNULL([Suscriptor].CuentaConfirmada, 0) WHEN 1 THEN 'Sí' ELSE 'No' END AS [CuentaConfirmada],
		[Suscriptor].[FechaConfirmacion],
		CASE ISNULL([Suscriptor].[Habilitado], 0) WHEN 1 THEN 'Sí' ELSE 'No' END AS [Habilitado],		
		[Suscriptor].[FechaCreacion],
		[Suscriptor].[CreadoPor],
		[Suscripcion].[FechaModificacion],
		[Suscripcion].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @SuscriptorFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[Suscriptor] ON [Suscriptor].[Id] = filter.[Suscriptor_Id] 
        JOIN [Suscripcion] ON [Suscripcion].[Suscriptor_Id] = [Suscriptor].[Id]
        JOIN [Membresia] ON [Membresia].[Id] = [Suscripcion].[Membresia_Id]
        LEFT JOIN [Comunidad] ON [Comunidad].[Id] = [Membresia].[Comunidad_Id]
        LEFT JOIN [TipoMembresia] ON [TipoMembresia].[Id] = [Membresia].[TipoMembresia_Id]
        LEFT JOIN [TipoSuscripcion] ON [TipoSuscripcion].[Id] = [Suscripcion].[TipoSuscripcion_Id]
	WHERE [Suscriptor].[Activo]= 1	
	AND [Membresia].[Activo] = 1
	AND [Membresia].[EstatusMembresia_Id] = 1
	AND [Suscripcion].[Activo] = 1
      
END
